goal: Verify that a user can create a new account, save a memo, and navigate the calendar to view the next month.
instructions: On the 'Create your account' page, enter 'alice' into the 'Username' field and 'SecureP@ss123!' into the 'Password' field, then click the 'Sign up' button.
In the main dashboard, type 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' into the text area labeled 'Any thoughts...' and click the 'Save' button.
Locate the calendar widget displaying 'June 2026' and click the right-pointing arrow button to navigate to the next month.
success_criteria: The user is successfully logged in and the dashboard displays the calendar for 'June 2026'.
The memo 'Remember to review the project timeline tomorrow morning.' appears in the feed below the input area.
The calendar widget updates to display 'July 2026' after clicking the navigation arrow.
The previously saved memo remains visible in the feed after navigating to the new month.
